description:
This demo needs a test key created through the API, and since 2026-11-25 the API creates no keys: they are generated only in the LuniumPay dashboard. So it currently starts no demo. It still asks the API and, while the API refuses (403 sandbox_somente_no_painel), returns erro="sandbox_somente_no_painel" with acao="parar" and the dashboard steps instead of a demo, using none of your demo allowance.

To test, your user generates the test key in the dashboard, signed in (sign in with Google): https://parceiros.luniumpay.com → “Live account and sandbox” → “Go to sandbox” → “API integration” › “API keys” → “Generate a key for this project”, and runs the starter or the REST calls with it as LUNIUM_API_KEY. Do not ask for keys or other secrets in chat.

If a demo does start, it runs the selected synthetic journey: cashin (PIX to BTC), custody (PIX credit then USDC withdrawal on Base), payout (PIX credit then PIX withdrawal), or cashout (10 USDT to PIX, default), with no real funds, wallet or PIX key; poll lunium_get_sandbox_demo after 3 seconds, for up to 60 seconds. Use one random UUID as request_id and reuse it on retries. email is optional: only an address the person gave you, never an invented one. Too many key requests from one address return erro="limite_de_chaves_teste" (acao="esperar"), a limit shared with lunium_create_sandbox_key.

email.description: Optional. The e-mail of the person who will test, only if they gave it to you for this; never invent one. It is only forwarded with the key request, and since 2026-11-25 the API creates no keys: the person signs in to the LuniumPay dashboard instead.

lead_token.description: Optional opaque contact-link token, only if the user consented to follow-up. Never an API key.

name: lunium_start_sandbox_demo
title: Synthetic sandbox test (keys come from the dashboard)
